patch_description: The current code just returns random points, giving a near-zero min/max ratio. A much better approach is to directly optimize the packing objective: maximize the minimum pairwise distance subject to the diameter (max pairwise distance) being at most 1, so the resulting ratio dmin/dmax equals the optimized dmin. I use SLSQP with multiple fixed-seed random starts initialized on the unit sphere (a good basin for spherical packings). The best local optimum over the starts is returned. This should approach the reference squared ratio (~0.24) instead of ~0.00.
